title: Rethinking LLM Pruning via Test-Time Scaling
abstract: arXiv:2611.01133v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Structured pruning reduces the size of large language models, often at the cost of lower accuracy. Whether this decline reflects diminished reasoning capacity or greater difficulty in sampling correct solutions is less clear. We examine this question across expert, FFN and layer pruning on four mathematical and coding benchmarks, comparing original and pruned models through pass@k at matched sampling budgets. Even after substantial pruning, some models match or exceed the original model's reasoning coverage despite lower pass@1, and solve problems left unsolved in the original samples. Retaining broad coverage, however, does not mean that correct solutions remain easy to obtain. Under severe pruning, diverse generated chain-of-thought (CoT) traces can coexist with increased repetition and less reliable generation. translated_title: 通过测试时扩展重新思考大语言模型剪枝
translated_abstract: 结构化剪枝可以减小大语言模型的规模，但通常会以准确率下降为代价。这种性能下降究竟反映了推理能力的减弱，还是仅仅使得采样出正确解变得更困难，目前尚不清楚。我们在四个数学和编程基准测试上，针对专家剪枝、FFN剪枝和层级剪枝考察了这一问题，在匹配的采样预算下通过pass@k指标比较原始模型与剪枝后的模型。研究发现，即使经过大幅剪枝，一些模型尽管pass@1较低，仍能达到甚至超过原始模型的推理覆盖范围，并能解决原始采样中未能解决的问题。然而，保持广泛的覆盖范围并不意味着正确解仍然容易获得。在重度剪枝下，多样化的思维链生成可能与重复内容增加、生成可靠性下降并存。随着正确答案变得更难采样，额外的尝试可能会急剧增加总的token使用量，即使单个……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 本文通过pass@k评估发现剪枝模型的推理能力未必真正下降，其性能损失更多源于正确解采样难度的增加，因此测试时扩展是重新评估和恢复剪枝模型性能的有效视角。
en_tdlr: This paper shows through pass@k evaluation that pruned LLMs' reasoning coverage is often preserved despite lower pass@1, indicating the performance drop stems mainly from harder sampling of correct solutions rather than diminished reasoning capacity, thus test-time scaling offers a new lens for rethinking LLM pruning.
